rows: Stay down. It suits you.
That is the ward, friend. It does not care who you were.
Somebody had to be first. Might as well have been me.
Get up when you can. I will be about.
Look at that. The floor of the Gull, and you on it.
I have carried heavier than you off this boards.
You picked the wrong hand to swing at, and now everybody watched.
There. Now the room knows my name and not yours.
Twice. A man could make a living out of you.
You keep coming back and I keep going up. Do not stop.
They are starting to ask who I am. That is your doing.
Second time. There will not need to be a fourth.
There are men who will work for me now. You bought them for me.
I have a house of my own out of this. You should see the roll.
Every hand on that trade answers to me, and it started with you on your back.
A guild, they call it. I call it what your face paid for.
The ground under this ward is mine to let. Ask the Flame.
I hold the charge now. You are standing on it.
They put my name on the roll this morning. A thing is true when it is on the roll.
Den Duke. Say it once so I can hear how it sounds in your mouth.
What I want is for you to remember whose house this is.
Nothing. That is the point. I do not need anything from you any more.
I want you to keep walking in here. It has been good for me.
You have asked me that from the floor twice now.
What I want is a third time, and then I am done with you.
Ask the men who work for me. They will tell you what I want.
I want what any Craftlord wants. Hands, ground, and quiet.
There is a house behind me now. You are talking to all of it.
Come and see the yard some time. Bring your purse; you will need it.

notes: S8 addition. The owner's content/raws/barks/barks.json is UNTOUCHED and always loads FIRST -- see barkRawsFiles, where the merge rule is that the first file to carry a key wins -- so nothing in here can take a line the owner wrote. These are the tables a NEMESIS speaks from: the man who put the player on the floor, taunting over them, and answering the one topic that exists because of it. Keys are picked by NemesisBook::recordDefeat and resolved by the room through the ordinary fallback chain; no C++ anywhere writes one of these sentences.
